items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Anyway, that was with Kenny Drew, and no more there. Art Taylor.

ctx.x: Can you talk about that date?

Yeah, [inaudible] that was all the guys and [dead unfortunately?]. There was Orrin Keepnews. He wanted me make a record with Riverside Records so it was [inaudible], you know. And back at the [inaudible] [were then?]. And I was still playing a lot of guitar and not whistling yet, I think. Anyway, that was with Kenny Drew, and no more there. Art Taylor. No more there. Wilbur Ware, who played with Monk, [right?]. And Pepper Adams. With baritone. So we had some [inaudible] and baritone. Many people say, you know,…
In 1958, for Decca Records, Time Out.
